Spatial boundaries of the 10 Barcelona districts

shapefile_bcn.Rd

Spatial boundaries of the 10 administrative districts of Barcelona, provided as an sf object. The dataset is used alongside the simulated barcelona_temp dataset to facilitate spatial visualisation and examples in the dlnmLPS package.

Usage

shapefile_bcn

Format

An sf object with 10 features and 2 columns:

District

District identifier, ranging from 01 to 10.

geometry

Spatial geometry of each Barcelona district, represented as POLYGON or MULTIPOLYGON features.

The geometries use the ETRS89 / UTM zone 31N coordinate reference system (EPSG:25831).

Source

Barcelona City Council, Open Data BCN. Districtes i barris. https://opendata-ajuntament.barcelona.cat/data/dataset/20170706-districtes-barris/resource/11851135-6919-4dcb-91ed-821e5e87a428

Details

The district boundaries correspond to the 10 administrative districts of Barcelona and can be linked to the District variable in barcelona_temp.

Unlike barcelona_temp, which contains simulated data, the spatial boundaries in this dataset originate from the Barcelona City Council Open Data BCN portal.

See also

barcelona_temp

Examples

data(shapefile_bcn)

library(sf)
#> Linking to GEOS 3.14.1, GDAL 3.12.2, PROJ 9.7.1; sf_use_s2() is TRUE
plot(shapefile_bcn["District"])
